_comment: Port rules of the security-group engine. Add your own with CLOUDGUARD_RULES_FILE (same shape). family: admin | database | remote. cis lists verified CIS mappings only; empty means no direct CIS control.

port_rules.title: SSH (22) open to the internet
port_rules.description: An ingress rule allows TCP port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0.
port_rules.remediation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 source. Allow SSH only from a trusted CIDR (office/VPN) or a bastion security group, or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of open SSH.

cis.title: Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports

port_rules.title: PostgreSQL (5432) open to the internet
port_rules.description: An ingress rule allows TCP port 5432 from 0.0.0.0/0.
port_rules.remediation: Replace the 0.0.0.0/0 source with the security group of the application tier that needs database access, and keep the database in a private subnet without a public IP.
